name: Codex
summary: OpenAI's coding agent, with an open-source CLI written in Rust that runs locally in the terminal. The same agent is offered as an IDE extension, a desktop app and a cloud version in ChatGPT. Commands run in an OS-level sandbox, and the CLI can act as an MCP client.
facts: Seatbelt on macOS, Landlock/seccomp on Linux
ChatGPT plan sign-in or API key
CLI, IDE extension, desktop app, web
watchOut: Sandboxing depends on host Landlock/seccomp support
Windows users are pointed to WSL or Docker in the security guide
